### Objective
Teachers post to the stream from their phone.

### Ownership
- **Team:** MOBILE | **Sprint:** 3
- **Depends on:** [MOBILE 2.1]
- **PRD:** `docs/PRD.md` FR-2.1, FR-2.2 (behavior is defined there, not in this issue)
- One issue = one PR. The team works its issues one at a time, in step order. Do not edit another team's folder; shared paths (`contracts/`, `design-system/`, `rules/`) are Lead-owned.

### Contract & Mock Hub
- **Contract:** `POST /api/announcements`
- **Mock hub:** Build against `python3 scripts/mock_hub.py` (seed accounts in `rules/developer-tooling-and-testing.md`). Switch to the real Hub on integration day.

### Sub-Tasks & Implementation Checklist
- [ ] FAB (56dp) and full-screen dialog with title, content and the comments toggle.
- [ ] Posting requires the Hub: when offline, disable the send button and show the Hub status message (do not queue announcements).
- [ ] Show success toast and refresh the feed.

### Target Files
- `mobile/app/src/main/java/org/lara/app/ui/screens/teacher/PostAnnouncement.kt`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A post from the phone appears on a second client via the mock hub push event.
- [ ] With the Hub unreachable the screen shows its offline state from local data; no blocking error.
- [ ] Every string is in English and Filipino, design tokens only, touch targets at least 52dp (56dp primary).
- [ ] `./gradlew test lint` (in `mobile/`) passes and its output is in the PR.

### Docs & Design
- Update `mobile/docs/` with purpose, key files, data flow and gotchas (PR requirement).
- **Design system:** design-system/design-system.md sections 5.1, 5.2, 5.7, 5.8. Layout: the Google Classroom screen this copies, per the screen map in `design-system/design-system.md` (section 9).
- Verification evidence required in the PR: log or screenshot against the mock hub (and the real Hub when available), WAN unplugged.

issues.body:
### Objective
A teacher can post and fix classwork from the phone, the same as on desktop.

### Ownership
- **Team:** MOBILE | **Sprint:** 3
- **Depends on:** [MOBILE 3.1], [MOBILE 3.4], [SERVER 3.4], [SERVER 3.5] (mock hub until merged)
- **PRD:** `docs/PRD.md` FR-2.4, FR-3.1, FR-3.3, FR-3.5, FR-3.6, FR-3.7 (behavior is defined there, not in this issue)
- One issue = one PR. The team works its issues one at a time, in step order. Do not edit another team's folder; shared paths (`contracts/`, `design-system/`, `rules/`) are Lead-owned.

### Contract & Mock Hub
- **Contract:** `POST /api/materials`, `PATCH` / `DELETE /api/materials/{id}`, `POST /api/assignments`, `PATCH` / `DELETE /api/assignments/{id}`, `POST /api/topics`, `PATCH` / `DELETE /api/topics/{id}`
- **Mock hub:** Build against `python3 scripts/mock_hub.py` (seed accounts in `rules/developer-tooling-and-testing.md`). Switch to the real Hub on integration day.

### Sub-Tasks & Implementation Checklist
- [ ] Upload a material (document or video) from the phone's files with a progress bar. Stream the upload from disk; never read the whole file into memory. Refuse files over 250 MB before uploading.
- [ ] Create and edit an assignment: title, instructions, maximum points, due date, allow late, topic, attachments.
- [ ] Edit and Delete in each item's menu; delete asks for confirmation and, for an assignment, says turned-in work and grades are kept.
- [ ] Create, rename and delete topics; Classwork groups items under them.
- [ ] Attach files to an assignment or announcement (materials with `assignment_id` or `announcement_id`).
- [ ] Uploads run in WorkManager so the vendor battery killer cannot drop them; a failed upload can be retried.

### Target Files
- `mobile/app/src/main/java/org/lara/app/ui/screens/teacher/classwork/*`
- `mobile/app/src/main/java/org/lara/app/data/repository/ClassworkAuthoringRepository.kt`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] With the mock hub: an assignment created on the phone appears for a learner account after one sync; an edited title updates; a deleted one disappears.
- [ ] Heap stays under 250 MB while a large video uploads (profiler screenshot in the PR, emulator numbers labelled as such).
- [ ] Deleting a topic leaves its work visible under no topic.
- [ ] With the Hub unreachable the screen shows its offline state from local data; no blocking error.
- [ ] Every string is in English and Filipino, design tokens only, touch targets at least 52dp (56dp primary).
- [ ] `./gradlew test lint` (in `mobile/`) passes and its output is in the PR.

### Docs & Design
- Update `mobile/docs/` with purpose, key files, data flow and gotchas (PR requirement).
- **Design system:** design-system/design-system.md sections 5.2, 5.8, 5.9, 5.12. Layout: the Google Classroom screen this copies, per the screen map in `design-system/design-system.md` (section 9)
- Verification evidence required in the PR: log or screenshot against the mock hub (and the real Hub when available), WAN unplugged. Include a "How to test" section a non-programmer can follow.

issues.body:
### Objective
A learner can ask the teacher about one assignment privately, and always sees what is not turned in yet.

### Ownership
- **Team:** MOBILE | **Sprint:** 3
- **Depends on:** [MOBILE 3.2], [MOBILE 3.6], [SERVER 3.5] (mock hub until merged)
- **PRD:** `docs/PRD.md` FR-3.8, FR-3.9 (behavior is defined there, not in this issue)
- One issue = one PR. The team works its issues one at a time, in step order. Do not edit another team's folder; shared paths (`contracts/`, `design-system/`, `rules/`) are Lead-owned.

### Contract & Mock Hub
- **Contract:** `GET` / `POST /api/assignments/{id}/private-comments`, `POST /api/sync/push` (`private_comments`), `private_comments`
- **Mock hub:** Build against `python3 scripts/mock_hub.py` (seed accounts in `rules/developer-tooling-and-testing.md`). Switch to the real Hub on integration day.

### Sub-Tasks & Implementation Checklist
- [ ] Private comments card on the learner's assignment screen and in the teacher's review screen (per learner). Read from Room.
- [ ] A comment written with the Hub unreachable is saved as `QUEUED_FOR_SYNC`, shown with the queued badge, and pushed by the sync worker; mark `SYNCED` only from the receipt.
- [ ] To-do screen: the learner's assignments with no submission, soonest due date first (Not turned in yet, Due soon, Done), built only from Room.
- [ ] Collapsed 'Due soon' panel on Home.
- [ ] Use the words from the design system's classroom words table ('Not turned in yet', never 'Missing', for a learner).

### Target Files
- `mobile/app/src/main/java/org/lara/app/ui/screens/todo/*`
- `mobile/app/src/main/java/org/lara/app/ui/components/PrivateComments.kt`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] With the mock hub: a learner's private comment appears for the teacher under that learner only, and the reply reaches the learner after one sync.
- [ ] A second learner account never sees the first learner's thread.
- [ ] A comment written in airplane mode is delivered once after reconnecting.
- [ ] To-do and Due soon are correct in airplane mode.
- [ ] With the Hub unreachable the screen shows its offline state from local data; no blocking error.
- [ ] Every string is in English and Filipino, design tokens only, touch targets at least 52dp (56dp primary).
- [ ] `./gradlew test lint` (in `mobile/`) passes and its output is in the PR.

### Docs & Design
- Update `mobile/docs/` with purpose, key files, data flow and gotchas (PR requirement).
- **Design system:** design-system/design-system.md sections 5.10, 5.12. Layout: the Google Classroom screen this copies, per the screen map in `design-system/design-system.md` (section 9)
- Verification evidence required in the PR: log or screenshot against the mock hub (and the real Hub when available), WAN unplugged. Include a "How to test" section a non-programmer can follow.
